economics.definition: Lowercase strip the canonical query text and count Unicode word tokens with (?u)\b\w+\b.
economics.limitations: Track-local descriptive slice; thresholds cannot be changed after scores are observed.
economics.sample_rule: No cross-track pooling. n=0 is NA; n=1-9 reports point estimates only with no CI or win claim; n>=10 uses 10000 paired bootstrap samples with seed 20260826. Never merge bins.

economics.definition: For each positive document compute |unique lowercase Unicode query tokens intersect unique document tokens| / |unique query tokens| and use the maximum across positives.
economics.limitations: Measures surface token overlap, not semantic overlap; positive texts stay local and restricted.
economics.sample_rule: No cross-track pooling. n=0 is NA; n=1-9 reports point estimates only with no CI or win claim; n>=10 uses 10000 paired bootstrap samples with seed 20260826. Never merge bins.

economics.definition: Count lowercase Unicode word tokens for every positive document and bin each query by the median positive-document token count.
economics.limitations: Canonical word-token length is not the model tokenizer length and does not directly identify truncation.
economics.sample_rule: No cross-track pooling. n=0 is NA; n=1-9 reports point estimates only with no CI or win claim; n>=10 uses 10000 paired bootstrap samples with seed 20260826. Never merge bins.

economics.definition: Count unique canonical positive qrel document IDs per query after canonical materialization validation.
economics.limitations: Qrel density reflects annotation multiplicity and is not corpus prevalence.
economics.sample_rule: No cross-track pooling. n=0 is NA; n=1-9 reports point estimates only with no CI or win claim; n>=10 uses 10000 paired bootstrap samples with seed 20260826. Never merge bins.
